title: 4.18 Critical regions and errors

q.Q1: Q1. X ~ B(20, 0.5) under H₀; H₁: p > 0.5 at 5%. P(X ≥ 14) = 0.0577, P(X ≥ 15) = 0.0207. Find the critical region and the actual significance level.

q.Q2: Q2. If in fact p = 0.7, find the probability of a type II error for the test above.

q.Q3: Q3. A machine should fill 500 g bags. A sample of 25 has x̄ = 497, σ = 6 known. Test H₀: μ = 500 vs H₁: μ < 500 at 5%.

q.Q4: Q4. n = 12 pairs give r = 0.62 with p-value 0.031 (two-tailed). Conclude at 5%.
